catalysts.headline: Bloom Energy analyst price-target raises: UBS to $325 from $300, Clear Street to $330 from $290, both Buy, both citing the S&P 500 addition
catalysts.magnitude: vs ~$265 Friday close (coordinator-supplied, not re-verified): UBS +22.6%, Clear Street +24.5% upside; raises were +8.3% and +13.8% vs prior targets. Both firms tied the raise to the inclusion (executed 09-21 open), so part of the target rationale is now spent; UBS's stated remaining leg is passive funds eventually owning 10-15% of shares outstanding (UBS estimate, not a disclosed holding). Two sell-side targets, not consensus

catalysts.headline: Intel (exited) jumps 4.03% to $101.05 on Reuters report SK Hynix is in talks to make memory chips in the US, possibly leasing part of Intel's Ohio complex or a JV; no deal announced
catalysts.magnitude: talks only, no terms, capacity or timeline; Melius reiterated Buy with $165 target (~63% above $101.05) and $200 in two years, a single-firm view. Re-buy read: the news is a named foundry customer prospect, but INTC already ran to $101 (a $110 print was quoted 09-17), so a re-buy setup depends on price, not on this headline. Also touches held SKHY/MU only as the same Ohio-talks story already in the SK Hynix/Solidigm item

catalysts.headline: Broadcom (exited): OpenAI first custom chip (Jalapeno) built with Broadcom; 1.3 GW deployment in 2027 with line of sight above 5 GW across first two generations; second-gen tape-out pending
catalysts.magnitude: stock ~$364.38, -13.7% over the month (Simply Wall St, undated snapshot); AI revenue targets of $115bn FY27 / $230bn FY28 are analyst projections per the cited coverage, not company guidance I verified. Pullback plus a named customer ramp is a re-buy setup; the Amodei-driven multiple compression that hit AVGO (-4% on 09-14) is the counter-force. Broadcom's 09-02 Q3 report beat/miss NOT established here

catalysts.headline: Vistra (exited 09-09) prices $850 million underwritten public equity offering
catalysts.magnitude: $850m vs ~$47.2bn market cap (snippet figure, undated) = ~1.8% dilution, far smaller than Corning's open-ended $2bn ATM; shares quoted ~$141.44 vs consensus target $217.42 (aggregator, unverified). Reason to wait for the offering overhang to clear, not a thesis break

catalysts.headline: Super Micro (exited 09-14): Goldman Sachs reiterates Sell 09-16; SMCI fell >7% in the 09-14 week AI-infrastructure selloff then rebounded ~3%
catalysts.magnitude: counter-scale: FY26 revenue $39.1bn (+77.8%) and $60bn backlog per the cited coverage; stock ~$39.05 (52-wk $19.48-$58.78). A reiterated Sell is not a mechanism; no company-specific event found

catalysts.headline: Meta (exited 09-10): Connect keynote Wed 09-23 (AI glasses); 09-18 coverage frames Meta becoming a cloud operator; 2026 capex guide is $125-145bn (raised at Q2)
catalysts.magnitude: META $680.85 on 09-18, +25.2% in one month and +5.7% in the week, so a re-buy would be after a run, not a pullback; the Q2 capex raise (07-29) coincided with a ~10% one-day drop on free-cash-flow pressure (Fortune). Cloud-operator framing is a 24/7 Wall St headline/Zuckerberg hint, not a company announcement I verified. Meta capex is demand for the held semis chain (tailwind to the book), threat only to META's own FCF
